mapper.sql: select id, student_id, avatar, push_flag, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from cf_checkout
mapper.select:
SELECT co.id, co.student_id, cs.`name` as student_name, cs.dept_id, sd.dept_name, co.avatar, co.push_flag, co.create_time FROM cf_checkout co LEFT JOIN cf_student cs on cs.id = co.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd on sd.dept_id = cs.dept_id
and co.push_flag = #{pushFlag} and DATE(co.create_time) = CURDATE() and cs.dept_id = #{deptId}
and date_format(co.create_time,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
and date_format(co.create_time,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%Y%m%d')
and cs.`name` like concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')
order by co.create_time desc

SELECT cs.dept_id AS deptId, sd.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(DISTINCT co.student_id) AS count FROM cf_checkout co LEFT JOIN cf_student cs ON cs.id = co.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.dept_id = cs.dept_id WHERE DATE(co.create_time) = CURDATE() AND (co.del_flag IS NULL OR co.del_flag = '0') GROUP BY cs.dept_id, sd.dept_name ORDER BY sd.dept_name
